sources.title: TrOCR · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TrOCR is a text recognition model for both image understanding and text generation. It doesn't require separate models for image processing or character generation. TrOCR is a simple single end-to-end system that uses a transformer to handle visual understanding and text generation.

sources.title: Free Online OCR Tool - Extract Text from Images & PDFs | i2OCR
sources.snippet: i2OCR is a free online OCR tool that extracts text from images and PDFs using AI-powered optical character recognition. Supports 128 languages. Convert image and PDF files to editable, searchable text online.
